reason: My architect already does 3D for us and it's baked into the design fee, so paying $1,500 a home on top of that is paying twice for something I already get. I'd have to see a real reason to add a vendor.
objection: My architect already does 3D for us. Why would I pay a second company per home for what's already covered, and who do I call when the renders don't match the plans we actually build?
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper and faster than what my architect charges for revisions, or if it showed buyers on spec homes finishes and options that my architect's renders don't, and I could see that on one of my own plans first.
